svg.title: Self-distillation without labels: two different crops of the same tissue tile go to a student network and a teacher network; the student learns to match the teacher, and the teacher is a slowly updated average of the student.
svg.text: Self-distillation in the style of DINO, the recipe behind many pathology foundation models.
Color and scale augmentations push the model to ignore stain differences and attend to morphology. Tiles are illustrative.
